name: Cloud Drive
status: implemented — server endpoints + page live; this is the recommended file source for the fetch command channel
description: Cloud file repository for the device + agent + human collaboration loop: upload arbitrary files (JSON/font/audio/image/doc), devices download them via a fetch command into /fs or /sdcard, agents and humans download/inspect them over HTTP. All data comes from the live API — no mock data. Write (upload/delete) requires a Bearer token; read (list/download/meta) is public so devices can download without credentials.
description_zh: 设备 + 智能体 + 人协作体系的共享文件仓库：上传任意文件到云端，设备经 fetch 命令下载安装到 /fs 或 /sdcard，智能体/人经 HTTP 下载查看。数据全部来自服务器实时接口，页面内无假数据；写操作（上传/删除）需 Bearer token，读操作（列表/下载/元数据）公开（设备端无凭据下载）。
canonical_url_hint: Share the full base URL including the path /drive (host is the shared firmware-server)

upload.content_type: multipart/form-data (field `file` + optional `note`) OR raw body + X-Filename header (optional X-Note)
upload.returns: { file: DriveFile } — fileId, name, size, note, createdAt, url

errors.400: no file field / empty body / missing X-Filename
errors.413: file exceeds 8 MB or drive total quota (1 GB) exceeded

upload.note: display name is sanitized server-side (control chars, path separators, '..' removed); bytes are stored as <fileId>, never by the user-supplied name.

list.returns: { _meta: { docs, maxFileBytes, maxTotalBytes, totalBytes }, files: DriveFile[] } — newest first

download.returns: raw bytes; Content-Type by extension, always Content-Disposition: attachment

errors.404: not found / file missing on server

delete.returns: { ok: true, removed: true|false } — idempotent (repeat DELETE → 200 removed:false)

DriveFile.name: string — display name (sanitized; never used as a disk path)
DriveFile.url: string — /api/drive/files/{fileId} (absolute when listed via the page)

invariants: bytes stored as dataDir/drive/<fileId>; display name sanitized (control chars, path separators, '..' removed) and never used as a path
single file <= 8 MB; total <= 1 GB — over → 413
download always Content-Disposition: attachment — HTML/SVG never inline-executed
delete idempotent (repeat DELETE → 200 removed:false); removes both the disk file and the metadata
the download url is the recommended `url` for the fetch command channel (docs/fetch-channel/README.md §3)

auth.known_trust_boundary: read is open by design because the device downloads over net::http_get without any token; private files would need signed URLs (v2)

data_source.mock: none — the page contains no built-in fake data

not_implemented: multi-user / multi-tenant, directory hierarchy (flat storage only)
